idea-plugin.name: Problems View
idea-plugin.description:
Provides the Problems tool window. The tool window shows the problems that the IDE finds in the project.
The Current File tab lists the code issues of the file that is open in the editor. The list changes when you switch to another file. The Project Errors tab lists the errors that the project-wide analysis finds.
Select a problem to read its description and to see the code in the preview. Double-click a problem to go to the related line in the editor, then apply a quick-fix. Filter the problems by severity, and group them by folder or by severity.
Other plugins add their own tabs to the same tool window such as Qodana and Vulnerable Dependencies.
